name: Enterprise Diagnostics
tagline: AI-powered operational intelligence for private equity portfolio companies.
description: Enterprise Diagnostics provides a sophisticated AI-driven platform designed to uncover hidden operational friction within private equity portfolio companies. Built on the Palantir Foundry architecture, the system delivers a comprehensive 60-day diagnostic roadmap to drive efficiency and value creation. The platform enables PE firms to identify and execute on operational improvements with high precision and speed.

founders.name: Michael Cupps
founders.bio: Experienced technology executive with a focus on enterprise intelligence and operational optimization for the financial sector.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Launched on Wefunder to bring AI-powered diagnostics to the broader investment community.

highlights: Built on Palantir Foundry for high-scale data analysis
Focused on the high-value Private Equity portfolio market
Delivers a complete operational roadmap in 60 days
6.95 quality score on initial review

name: Faxo
tagline: The social super-app designed to replace $2 trillion worth of fragmented apps.
description: Faxo is a comprehensive 'Everything App' that unifies social media, e-commerce, and productivity into a single platform. With a strong initial foothold as a top-ranked social app in the U.S. App Store, it currently serves over 1.3 million users. The platform focuses on high engagement and high conversion rates for its subscription-based and marketplace features.

founders.name: Steve Urciuoli
founders.bio: Repeat founder with 36 years of experience shipping large-scale systems for Fortune 100s and government agencies.

updates.title: User Growth Milestone
updates.body: Reached 1.3 million total users with 23K+ Daily Active Users (DAU) and 24% engagement.

highlights: 1.3 million users and counting
Ranked #32 in the U.S. App Store Social category
Led by a founder with 36 years of enterprise systems experience
High 22% subscription conversion rate

name: UNFIT TOO
tagline: The definitive documentary sequel examining challenges to American Democracy.
description: UNFIT TOO is a feature-length documentary film featuring leading experts discussing the evolving challenges to Democracy in America today. Following the success of the 2020 film #UNFIT, the production team is reuniting to deliver a deep dive into the current political climate ahead of the 2026 midterms. The film is led by an Emmy-winning director with a track record of high-impact non-fiction storytelling.

founders.name: Daniel Partland
founders.bio: Multiple Emmy winner and documentary veteran known for 'Intervention' and 'God & Country'.

updates.title: Production Update
updates.body: Secured key expert interviews for the documentary as production moves toward its 2026 release goal.

highlights: Sequel to the 2020 hit documentary #UNFIT
Produced by an Emmy-winning director
Targeting release before the 2026 midterm elections
Over $100k raised from the community

name: GoGoIPO Inc.
tagline: Democratizing asset-backed business ownership and IPO access.
description: GoGoIPO is a unique holding company and venture studio that builds asset-backed businesses, making private equity and IPO-style opportunities accessible to everyday investors. By focusing on income-producing assets such as real estate and fintech, the company provides a diversified investment vehicle designed for long-term capital allocation and growth. Their mission is to empower individual investors to participate in ventures traditionally reserved for Wall Street institutions.

founders.name: Arthur Derran Dresch
founders.bio: Finance veteran with over 20 years of experience in capital allocation and business development.

updates.title: Funding Progress
updates.body: Reached 243% of initial funding goal through the Wefunder community.

highlights: Asset-backed model for reduced investor risk
Democratizing institutional-grade investment opportunities
Founder has 20+ years of deep finance experience
Multi-sector approach across real estate and fintech

name: NAMS Wonton Crisps
tagline: Innovative wonton crisps disrupting the traditional snack category.
description: NAMS Wonton Crisps brings a modern, crunchy twist to Asian-inspired snacking. Starting with a presence in approximately 50 independent retail locations in New York, the brand is scaling rapidly through experienced CPG sales advisors. Led by an ex-JPMorgan analyst and restaurateur, the company is focused on high-quality ingredients and strong retail unit economics to capture a share of the growing savory snack market.

founders.name: Andres Siman
founders.bio: Former JPMorgan analyst and successful restaurateur who scaled prior sales by 10x in under 5 years.

updates.title: Retail Expansion
updates.body: Now stocked in 50+ independent stores across New York City.

highlights: Currently in ~50 independent New York stores
Led by an ex-JPMorgan founder with restaurant scaling experience
Low $3M valuation cap for early investors
Fast-growing presence in the CPG specialty snack category
